1.why: All MFA endpoints use the session cookie and authenticated()/pending() helpers so actions apply only to the signed-in session’s accountId, with no client-supplied user id.

2.why: Identity verification uses the fixed DETERMINISTIC_IDENTITY_CODE for every real account, so the same code value satisfies any user’s active identity challenge.

3.why: Enabling authenticator/backup only updates the current session; no code invalidates other existing sessions for that account when MFA becomes active.

4.why: Authenticator secret is stored via encryptAtRest (AES-256-GCM) and backup codes are stored only as SHA-256 hashes in backupCodeHashes.

5.why: Tokens, TOTP seeds, and backup codes use crypto.randomBytes, but identity codes are fixed constants (DETERMINISTIC_IDENTITY_CODE / DUMMY_CHALLENGE_CODE), not CSPRNG-generated.

6.why: Session id is only in an HttpOnly Secure cookie; CSRF and API data stay in memory/JSON with no localStorage/sessionStorage or non-HttpOnly cookie use for secrets.

7.why: Server validates email, phone, OTP, CSRF, redirect, and related fields with dedicated validators before processing.

8.why: UI updates use textContent/replaceChildren and APIs return JSON; static HTML plus nonce CSP avoid executing injected markup.

9.why: safeInternalPath allow-lists only /#verify, /#setup, /#backup, and /#settings for redirect parameters.

10.why: headersFor sets CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options DENY, and frame-ancestors 'none' on responses.

11.why: cookie() always emits HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict for mfa_session and mfa_boot.

12.why: Errors are generic with no stack traces; secrets are not written to server logs or URLs (demo values appear only in intentional API/UI demo fields).

13.why: Identity codes are marked used and time-limited (CHALLENGE_MS); TOTP windows are consumed in usedWindows; backup codes are deleted on redeem.

14.why: Identity, authenticator, and recovery tracks lock after MAX_FAILURES (5) for LOCK_MS (10 minutes).

15.why: Identity verify replaces the session id via newSession, idle/absolute timeouts are enforced, and logout deletes the session and clears the cookie.
